info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description: Implemented project-based MVP contract. Future workspace/v2 routes and expectedVersion are not implemented. Session cookies are HttpOnly; CSRF requires cookie plus header. Local versus Strict security alternatives describe deployment modes, not interchangeable cookies accepted by one deployment. Transport:RequireHttps selects cookie names; public HTTPS is the hosted default. Unknown/repeated collection query parameters are rejected case-insensitively; Enums and dynamic task PATCH field names are case-sensitive; typed body binding accepts name casing variants.

get.description: Responses include X-Trace-Id and Cache-Control: no-store. IDs remain decimal strings. Collection queries reject unsupported/repeated parameters; filters combine with AND. Paging defaults to 1/20, maximum pageSize 100; offset must fit Int32. Inaccessible/deleted resources return 404; visible forbidden operations return 403 where applicable.
